summary: Collector Crypt's new PayBox channel (buy packs inside ChatGPT, Claude or Grok) kept dominating pack talk, with several mid-size creators posting walkthroughs. Trust was the big collector worry again: the $660K fake PSA Rayquaza slab story spread, Singapore police said Pokémon cards top its e-commerce scam list, and a collector said three Facebook Marketplace deals were all fakes. Solflare Packs got a steady stream of small, positive community posts, and @solana_sailor's 'Solflare is just a wallet? Wrong' thread got the most reach (2.4k impressions). Pokémon 30th Anniversary and Delta Reign drops are driving heavy restock and lottery chatter ahead of the Nov 6 launch.

sources_note: X search via the x connector, posts from 2026-11-03 09:00 UTC to 2026-11-04 09:00 UTC, 6 post searches and 1 X news search. Engagement numbers are copied from the X API at scan time; post texts are trimmed. Collector Crypt and Phygitals sales figures come from unverified third-party posts. The GameStop Rolex pull is a creator citing a Superstonk post. The Mudwater, Pokémon 30th Anniversary and Pudgy Penguins items are X news summaries (Grok-written). Payments talk was thin: card, Apple Pay and Google Pay searches returned off-topic posts and a Walmart dispute; none were about buying collectibles with card in crypto apps. Skipped: restock bots (packpingnet), affiliate deal posts, resale DMs, $BREAK, $PJAM and $CARDS token shills, NFT mint promos, and dozens of near-identical HaloArena 'sold out in an hour' replies (likely a coordinated campaign). Creators already in collector-base.csv or earlier daily files (e.g. @witty_cruz, @LipeSolana, @diegoarmandoAD) were left out of new_creators. @AleksaFlamingo's 'no losers in pack opening' reply leans on gambling-style framing and is marked neutral.
